note: DRAFT input schemas used only until WS4 publishes twin/api/schemas/*.json. Published schemas replace these tool by tool. Shapes follow design-proposal section 11 and workstreams.md shared interfaces 2-4.

tools.name: resolve_place
tools.description: Turn an address or place name in Rome into coordinates, municipio and urban zone.

tools.name: context_check
tools.description: Sensitive sites, PRG component and constraints within a radius of a point, each with distance and source layer. Context, not a ban.

tools.name: estimate_field
tools.description: Electromagnetic field estimate on an area: P5/P50/P95 in V/m, probability of exceeding the attention value, model and calibration status.

area.description: Operating area: 'city', 'municipio:<n>' (1-15), 'zone:<CODE>' (urban-zone code, upper case) or a GeoJSON Polygon/MultiPolygon

tools.name: query_layer
tools.description: Belief-layer values (mean, uncertainty, data kind) for a layer on an area at a time.

area.description: Operating area: 'city', 'municipio:<n>' (1-15), 'zone:<CODE>' (urban-zone code, upper case) or a GeoJSON Polygon/MultiPolygon

tools.name: run_scenario
tools.description: Run a what-if scenario on an operating area. Returns baseline vs variant indicators with ranges.

area.description: Operating area: 'city', 'municipio:<n>' (1-15), 'zone:<CODE>' (urban-zone code, upper case) or a GeoJSON Polygon/MultiPolygon

tools.name: legal_lookup
tools.description: Search official Italian and EU legal sources (Normattiva, Gazzetta Ufficiale, AgID, Garante, ARPA Lazio, Roma Capitale...). Returns quoted text with URL and retrieval time.

tools.name: find_dataset
tools.description: Search official open-data portals for a dataset the twin does not have yet. Returns quoted pages with URL.

tools.name: news_search
tools.description: Search municipal notices and local news for disruptions (roadworks, strikes, demonstrations). Unverified text.

tools.name: data_status
tools.description: Honesty panel: every layer with its data kind (real, estimated, simulated), provider and last update.

tools.name: permit_report
tools.description: Cited permit-context report built by code: location, context within the radius, field estimate, provenance. Returns markdown and the inner tool runs.
